html_source: Archduke Franz Ferdinand of Austria, the presumptive heir to the throne of the Austro-Hungarian empire whose assassination in Sarajevo in 1914 precipatated the Great War, in a photographic portrait ca. 1914 by Ferdinand Schmutzer, held in the Österreichische Nationalbibliothek, Vienna. Source: Wikimedia Commons.
